Reference Letter Global Foundry Engineering GmbH

Dear Sirs,

I wholeheartedly recommend GFE for the position of a consultant. The team would make an outstanding consultation in foundries.

GFE is not only creative; they possess the rare skills of being able to communicate his ideas and their associated benefits effectively. Simply put, they get results.

GFE is also very flexible and eager to take on new challenges. Team has all qualifications in light aluminum wheel casting process. I think it is very difficult to find consultants like they are if your business involves Low Pressure Die Casting and/or automotive industry.

From the 2013 onwards I have done projects with GFE, we have seen quick reactions. We are convinced that achievements are largely a result of GFE Team efforts. They are worth every penny.

Please don't hesitate to follow up if I can answer any questions about GFE and their skills.

Best regards,

Jörg Vossen Business Development Manager EKW GmbH
